summary: This 8-K reports a trust extension by SPAC Inception Growth Acquisition Ltd. On May 11, 2026, the company deposited $12,203.33 into its trust account to extend the deadline to complete a business combination from May 13, 2026, to June 13, 2026. The extension is for one month, providing additional time to find a target. No deal terms or advisors are mentioned as no target has been announced. The filing is a routine SPAC extension, not a special situation closure or termination. Watch for a future business combination announcement or another extension if no deal is reached by June 13.
